deviations_from_card: Tests and implementation committed together in e971a4b (the tests do not typecheck without sceneAt/dvr.ts); wiring in edc5327. Coupled file outside the write set: apps/stage/eslint-suppressions.json, PRUNED only (App.tsx react-hooks/refs 36 -> 33, via eslint --prune-suppressions; no suppression added) because the rewired render reads fewer refs and ESLint fails on unpruned suppressions. The window opens at the keyframe just before the oldest held event (scene after event #999 of 3000), not at the oldest held event itself. sceneAt returns {scene, t, clamped}. Clip markers in Controls are now placed by (at - start)/span instead of clipMarkers' frac so they align with a live track whose ring has evicted its start (identical for replays of sorted transcripts).
notes: No browser smoke against a live daemon: the App/Controls wiring is covered by typecheck, lint and build, and the logic by the 12 unit tests (store + pure transport + liveView). Live speed buttons now set the DVR playback speed only (the daemon subscription speed is fixed by ?speed=); playing at a higher speed than the subscription catches up to the head. One vitest run hit ENOTEMPTY on node_modules/.vitest-cache from a concurrent sibling run; the re-run was green.
